notes.title: Large update and a new episode!
notes.notes:
https://youtu.be/5d9OlJrbtW0

Mimpi finally comes back! We are happy to announce the release of a large game update and a gigantic new level Mars that is larger than all other levels together. 

This free update features:
[list][*]switch to Free2Play model, with premium DLCs
[*]premium DLC: new episode „Mars“
[*]new costumes for Mimpi
[*]improvements in all game levels
[*]new sounds and music[/list]
We hope that you will enjoy the free content and also the long-awaited new level, which could be easily nicknamed „Mimpi Dreams 2.“ 

Please let us know how do you like it.  We are already working on a new one. 

The Team of Mimpi Dreams
Dreadlocks Mobile

notes.notes:

Will you be able to beat the game and get the achievement? ːCuriousMimpiː

Note: You have to pass it in one sitting!
